question: At what CO2 flow rates were System 1 (the CO2 jet) and System 2 (the microbubbles) run, and what pore size did the microbubble diffuser have?
expect: System 1 6 L/min; System 2 0.5 L/min through a 2 μm stainless-steel diffuser (sec. 2.2.1-2.2.2)
rendered:
Based on the given documents, I found the information related to your question in the first document.

The microbubble diffuser had a porous size of 2 μm.
